entities.summary: The Royal Society of New South Wales is a learned society based in Sydney, Australia. The Governor of New South Wales is the vice-regal patron of the Society. It is the oldest learned society in the Southern Hemisphere. Royal Society of New South Wales is a academy of sciences in Oceania, established in 1821. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
